title: SynthData Generator Backend
summary: A FastAPI backend that generates synthetic tabular and text datasets from user-uploaded data, letting users pick per-column models such as CTGAN, TVAE, or GMM. It uses SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer) directly to generate synthetic numeric data.
evidence: backend/src/generator/numeric_generator.py:55-60 selects CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, or GaussianCopulaSynthesizer via sdv.single_table
